presets.name: Raise a glass
presets.description: A relaxed toast in a warm, crowded party scene.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the identity reference for one lead subject. Keep the same face, hairstyle, outfit and body proportions. Place the subject at a lively indoor evening party with warm crystal chandeliers, dark wood, and several distinct guests behind them. Medium waist-up framing, gentle handheld camera movement, one continuous four-second shot. The lead holds one small silver cup in the right hand, raises it from chest height in a short toast toward the camera, then brings it back to chest level. The left hand stays relaxed. Keep the cup shape and grip stable; no hand switching. Keep the lead recognizable throughout. Background guests remain different people. Natural anatomy and stable lighting. No text, logos, cuts or duplicate lead. Audio: quiet party ambience and an original understated instrumental beat, no recognizable song or lyrics.
